name: splicewire/laravel-beam-accounts
description: The account engine of the schemastud stack: Fortify/session as the default auth substrate, the whole self-service account runtime (profile/security surface + Fortify registration/reset actions), and the generic team/membership/invitation primitives on the permission-cascade base leaf. A capability peer of the beam family; concrete tenant-provisioning + demo stay in the consuming satellite. Not Passport.

suggest.laravel/sanctum: Install in a satellite to activate its own opt-in token 'api' guard seam alongside the engine's session/Fortify web guard.

package-topology.because: beam-accounts is the account engine and now OWNS the auth public surface relocated DOWN out of tower (HTTP-04/07/08): the TokenProvenance enum, AuthTokenFactory, the CentralRoot support helper, base AuthUserData + its AuthUserExtrasContributor port/config seam, and the 5 Api/V1/* auth controllers. That surface is consumed DOWN by the tower host (which requires beam-accounts) and by the host App tier; the engine itself depends DOWN on beam + the permission-cascade/fortify foundations and must NEVER reach UP into tower / satellite / the host App tier.

noRequire.because: the account engine is reusable by any beam site; the auth surface lives DOWN here and is consumed UP by the tower host (host-specific TowerAuthUserData/Extras subclass stays in tower) — beam-accounts never requires tower
the foundation never reaches up into the consumer-app tier
